This represents a waste-recycling approach to fertilizer production but the chunks do not discuss its carbon emissions or renewable energy use. Other chunks cover unrelated topics (low-carbon construction materials, synthetic methylotrophic bacteria for chemicals from methanol, and a catalyst for CO2-based methanol production), not fertilizer manufacturing.
